landing.heroSubtitle: A calm, reliable QR attendance system for colleges, schools, coaching institutes, and teams. Works right in the browser.
landing.markCardSubtitle: Scan the live rotating QR on screen or enter your 6-character ID and live code.
landing.stepsSub: Three simple steps to move off paper registers.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up in a minute, name your roles, and get a unique organization code.
landing.step2Desc: Add people one by one, upload a CSV sheet, or let them join using your code. Each person gets a unique 6-character ID and Digital ID Card.
landing.step3Desc: Open projector mode with a QR that rotates every 10 seconds and location verification. Everyone marks attendance in seconds.
landing.featuresSub: Everything your campus or team needs every day, nothing extra.
landing.feat1Desc: Project a QR and 6-digit code that refresh every 10 seconds with GPS radius verification.
landing.feat2Desc: Multiple faculty members independently run subject-wise sessions for the same class on the same day.
landing.feat3Desc: Subject-wise charts, monthly registers, shortage alerts, and one-click Excel (.xlsx), CSV, or branded PDF exports.
landing.feat4Desc: Students apply for leave in seconds and verified parents can monitor live attendance and shortages.
landing.feat5Desc: Installable web app that adapts cleanly from small phones to desktop screens.
landing.feat6Desc: Switch the entire interface between English and Hindi anytime without reloading.
landing.whoSub: One clean hierarchy that adapts to your organization's language.
landing.whoCollegeDesc: Track subject-wise lecture attendance across departments, classes, and timetables.
landing.whoSchoolDesc: Fast roll call with digital student ID cards, parent portals, and monthly registers.
landing.whoCoachingDesc: Spot low-attendance students early and keep batch records organized.
landing.whoCompanyDesc: Simple check-ins with live location checks, audit trails, and clean leave approvals.
landing.why1Desc: No training manual required. Clear labels, calm screens, and direct actions.
landing.why2Desc: Mark an entire class or team in under a minute with live rotating QR sessions.
landing.why3Desc: Rotating 10-second tokens, one-device-per-session lock, immutable audit logs, and strict organization isolation.
landing.faq1A: Yes. You can create your organization, add your team, and run live attendance sessions at no cost.
landing.faq2Q: Do members need to install an app?
landing.faq2A: No. They can open it in any browser, scan the live QR or enter their ID, and install to their home screen if they like.
landing.faq3Q: How is the unique ID made?
landing.faq3A: Every person receives a globally unique 6-character ID made from 3 letters of their name and 3 random digits (like PAN482).
landing.faq4Q: Can someone share a screenshot of the QR?
landing.faq4A: No. The live QR and 6-digit code rotate every 10 seconds, expire immediately on the server, check GPS distance, and allow only one person per device.
landing.faq5A: Yes. It is designed mobile-first so members can scan QR codes directly using their phone's camera.
landing.contactSub: Questions or feedback? Send us a short message.
landing.contactSent: Thank you. Your message has been sent.
landing.footerTagline: Calm QR attendance for everyday organizations.
